submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 at 32 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 93.305%, significantly outperforming Algorithm-L1 (84.666% at best) and Algorithm-L2 (73.333% at best). The systematic optimization scanned thresholds from 20-60 GeV and refined the search around the peak, confirming 32 GeV as optimal. This configuration provides approximately 8.6% higher efficiency than L1 and 20% higher than L2, meeting the goal of maximizing signal efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. CRITICAL NOTE: Latency data was not available during analysis (latency_data_available = 0), so compliance with the hard 4.0 μs latency constraint could not be verified. This should be validated before deployment.
